sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
The chest rig is modeled after a Spiritus Systems LV-119 Overt configured with a variety of commercially available accessories for breaching and sustainment. The loadout combines equipment from several manufacturers, including:
- Spiritus Systems LV-119 Overt Plate Bags with Spiritus Systems Shoulder Covers and a Spiritus Systems HLT Cummerbund
- Spiritus Systems Micro Fight Mk4 Chassis (MultiCam) fitted with an AXL Advanced Micro Fight Zipper Insert (MultiCam)
- Spiritus Systems Lunchbox Pouch Mk2 mounted beneath the placard in its folded configuration, together with breaching charge strips

- A Spiritus Systems MOLLE Back Panel attached the rear plate bag.
- A Blue Force Gear Single Smoke Pouch (Black), two Eagle Industries Strip Charge Pouches (Ranger Green), and an ACS Grenade Trigger Pouch (Green) mounted to the rear panel
- Two Spiritus Systems Medium GP Pouches in (MultiCam), and a MPRC Mk5 Radio Chassis Mounted to the Cummerbund
Additional equipment includes HK MP7 4.6x30 30-round magazines, an MPU5 networking radio with compatible MPU5 Push-to-Talk (PTT), and a Thyrm DarkVault Critical Gear Case.
